Lever and Wedges

You work the iron tip into the seam and tap a wedge into place.

Rules

ID: item-lever-and-wedges

Market price: 5 coins. Bulk: 1.

Reusable prying bar and wedges. Provides leverage where physically possible; no automatic Force progress or bonus.

Buying equipment grants no DP advancement, training or ability. Use normal item-handling actions unless an applicable card says otherwise.
